normalIntro.cn: 这个动词是名词 union 背后的动作：把几个变一。

normal.en: Uni- is one, and -te marks the verb of making one.
normal.cn: uni- 是「一」，-te 标记「使成一体」的动词。

normal.en: Unite against is the pattern for common enemies.
normal.cn: unite against 是面对共同敌人时的常用结构。

normal.en: United appears in the names of countries formed by joining.
normal.cn: united 出现在由联合而来的国名中。

normal.en: Unity is the state, union the body or the act, unite the deed.
normal.cn: unity 是状态，union 是实体或行为，unite 则是动作。

normal.en: Design unites beauty with strength is a common written pattern.
normal.cn: 「design unites beauty with strength」是常见的书面句型。

abstract.en: Picture two rivers meeting and running on as one.
abstract.cn: 想象两条河汇合后一起流。

abstract.en: See strangers passing buckets along a line to a fire.
abstract.cn: 看陌生人排成一列传递水桶去救火。

abstract.en: Hear a crowd break into one song.
abstract.cn: 听人群忽然唱成同一首歌。

examples.en: The workers united to demand safer conditions.
examples.cn: 工人们联合起来要求更安全的工作条件。

examples.en: Her speech united the room in a way no one expected.
examples.cn: 她的讲话以出人意料的方式让全场团结起来。

examples.en: The plan unites the old station with a modern glass hall.
examples.cn: 这个方案把老车站与现代化的玻璃大厅结合在一起。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「尤奈特」——尤尼是「一」，特指这一回，大家凑成一伙就是联合。

root: 拉丁语 unus（一）→ unire（使成一体）的过去分词 unitus，经古法语进入英语

sensesIntro.en: One verb covers joining bodies, standing together, blending qualities, healing division, and unifying a country.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个动词覆盖联合实体、并肩而立、融合品质、弥合分裂与统一国家。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two rivers running on as one.
core.cn: 核心意象：两条河汇成一条继续流。

branches.en: The joining branch: two parties becoming one body.
branches.cn: 结合分支：两方成为一个实体。

branches.en: The action branch: standing together over a cause.
branches.cn: 行动分支：为了一个目标并肩而立。

branches.en: The blending branch: qualities held in one thing.
branches.cn: 融合分支：品质集于一身。

branches.en: The harmony branch: division ended, agreement restored.
branches.cn: 和睦分支：分裂结束，重归一致。

branches.en: The national branch: provinces brought under one rule.
branches.cn: 国家分支：诸省归于一个政权。

intro.en: A Latin root for one plus a verb ending gives the action of making one.
intro.cn: 表示「一」的拉丁词根加动词词尾，给出「使成一体」的动作。

latinIntro.en: Unire, from unus, is the Latin source; unity and union share it.
latinIntro.cn: unire 出自 unus，是拉丁语来源，unity 与 union 同出这一词根。

items.meaningCN: 表示行为或结果的名词后缀
items.example: Union names the act of joining.
The treaty unifies the two systems.

definition_zh: 团结；统一；整体；协调；同一性（艺术、逻辑中）
definition_en: the state of being one, joined, or in agreement
core_image: 一张网上的许多结，都连着同一根主线
scene: 排练的时候，二十几把小提琴的弓角度一致，声音像一片。The orchestra played with remarkable unity.
sceneCN: 这里 unity 是「协调一致」（第 1 个义项：作为整体的一）；句意为乐团演奏得异常协调。许多结都连着同一根主线，正是这个词的核心画面。

derivatives.zh: 同根动词，义为「联合」
同根名词，义为「联合；工会」
同根形容词，义为「统一的；单一的」
同根动词，义为「统一；使一致」

senses.title: The state of being one
senses.definition: the condition of being joined into a single whole
senses.definitionCN: 合成为一个整体的状态
senses.example: The unity of the two halves was never fully achieved.
senses.exampleCN: 这两半始终没能真正合为一体。
senses.why: The Latin root unus, one, plus -itas names the state of being one.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词根 unus（一）加 -itas，命名的正是「是一体」的状态。

senses.title: Agreement among people
senses.definition: the condition of people agreeing and acting together
senses.definitionCN: 人们彼此一致、共同行动的状况
senses.example: The speech called for unity in a divided country.
senses.exampleCN: 这篇讲话呼吁分裂的国家团结起来。
senses.why: People who agree are one in purpose, so the same word serves for social harmony.
senses.whyCN: 意见一致的人在目的上是同一个，因此这个词也用于社会和睦。

senses.title: Harmony of parts in a work
senses.definition: the quality in a work that makes its parts belong together
senses.definitionCN: 让作品的各部分显得同属一体的品质
senses.example: The painting has a unity of colour that holds the eye.
senses.exampleCN: 这幅画在色彩上有一种统一感，把目光留在画里。
senses.why: Judging a work means checking whether its pieces return to one shape.
senses.whyCN: 评判一件作品，就是在看它的各个部分是否回到同一个形状。

senses.title: Singleness of aim
senses.definition: used of a shared purpose that directs a group
senses.definitionCN: 形容指引一个群体的共同目的
senses.example: The campaign was run with unity of purpose.
senses.exampleCN: 这场运动的推进目标一致。
senses.why: One aim is the practical shape of oneness in a working group.
senses.whyCN: 一个目标，是一体性在工作群体中的实际形态。

senses.title: Sameness in logic or mathematics
senses.definition: in technical use, the fact of being a single entity or value
senses.definitionCN: 在技术用法中，指为单一实体或单一数值
senses.example: The law of identity rests on the unity of a thing with itself.
senses.exampleCN: 同一律建立在事物与自身的一体性之上。
senses.why: The oldest philosophical question is whether one thing is really one, and unity names that.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的哲学问题就是一个事物是否真为「一」，而 unity 正是这件事的名字。

intro.en: The word comes from Latin unitas, oneness, built on unus, one.
intro.cn: 这个词来自拉丁语 unitas（一体），建立在 unus（一）之上。

items.en: Unus meant one, and unitas named the state of being one.
items.cn: unus 意为「一」，unitas 则是「一体」的状态。

items.en: The word passed into French and then into English.
items.cn: 该词经法语传入英语。

items.en: English used unity for religious and social oneness.
items.cn: 英语用 unity 表示宗教与社会的一体。

items.en: Political writing made unity a standard word for agreement.
items.cn: 政治写作使 unity 成为表示一致的标准用词。

items.en: Criticism borrowed it for harmony in art and music.
items.cn: 文艺批评借它表示艺术与音乐中的协调。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the uni- family, and the near-meaning group covers harmony and agreement.
note.cn: 形近组是 uni- 词族，近义组覆盖和谐与一致的说法。

entries.definition: to join
a joining or a workers body
forming one whole
not common
entries.definitionCN: 不寻常的（只是拼写相近，词源不同）

entries.definition: agreement of parts together
support within a group
sticking together as one
separation into parts

normalIntro.en: The word is the noun of oneness, so it covers a body, a crowd, a picture, and a purpose.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词是「一体」的名词，因此覆盖整体、人群、画面与目标。

normal.en: Uni- is one, and -ty names the state.
normal.cn: uni- 是「一」，-ty 命名的是那种状态。

normal.en: National unity is the phrase you meet in newspapers.
normal.cn: national unity 是报纸上常见的说法。

normal.en: Unity of purpose is a fixed phrase for shared aims.
normal.cn: unity of purpose 是表示共同目标的固定说法。

normal.en: Unity is uncountable, unlike union.
normal.cn: 与 union 不同，unity 不可数。

normal.en: Unite is the act, union the body, unity the condition.
normal.cn: unite 是动作，union 是实体，unity 是状况。

abstract.en: Picture many threads tied to a single line.
abstract.cn: 想象许多线系在同一根主线上。

abstract.en: See a choir breathe together before the first word.
abstract.cn: 看合唱团在第一个字前一起吸气。

abstract.en: Hear a hall agree without a single voice raised.
abstract.cn: 听满厅一致，没有一个人出声反对。

examples.en: The new leader promised to restore unity to the party.
examples.cn: 这位新领袖承诺让党内恢复团结。

examples.en: There is a striking unity between the two designs.
examples.cn: 两个设计之间有惊人的一致性。

examples.en: The novel is admired for the unity of its structure.
examples.cn: 这部小说的结构统一性为人称道。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「尤尼替」——尤尼是「一」，替是「替上」，众人替成一个，就是团结。

root: 拉丁语 unus（一）+ 名词词尾 -itas 构成 unitas（一体），经古法语进入英语

sensesIntro.en: One state, being one, appears as a whole, a crowd, a work of art, a shared aim, and a logical value.
sensesIntro.cn: 一种状态，是一体，表现为整体、人群、艺术作品、共同目标与逻辑上的单一。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: many threads knotted to the same main line.
core.cn: 核心意象：许多根线都系在同一根主线上。

branches.en: The whole branch: parts that have become one thing.
branches.cn: 整体分支：合成一物的各部分。

branches.en: The crowd branch: people in agreement.
branches.cn: 人群分支：意见一致的人们。

branches.en: The artwork branch: colour and form that hold together.
branches.cn: 作品分支：色彩与形式相守。

branches.en: The purpose branch: a single aim guiding a group.
branches.cn: 目标分支：指引群体的单一目标。

branches.en: The logical branch: the sameness of a thing with itself.
branches.cn: 逻辑分支：事物与自身同一。

intro.en: A Latin number plus a noun suffix for state gives the abstract word.
intro.cn: 拉丁语数词加表示状态的名词后缀，得到这个抽象名词。

latinIntro.en: Unus and unitas are the Latin sources for unity, unite, and union.
latinIntro.cn: unus 与 unitas 是 unity、unite、union 的拉丁来源。

items.meaningCN: 表示状态的拉丁语后缀

items.example: Union is the act and the body.
Harmony and unity are close twins.
items.exampleCN: harmony 与 unity 是近亲。

items.example: Solidarity is shared feeling, unity is one state.
items.exampleCN: solidarity 是共同情感，unity 是一体状态。

definition_zh: 普遍的；全体的；通用的；宇宙的
definition_en: true of or shared by everyone or everything, or able to be used in all cases
core_image: 一张巨大的圆顶把天南地北的人与物全罩在里面，没有一处露在边缘之外
scene: 孩子们在课堂上争论笑容是不是人人都懂，老师让全班用自己的语言演示同一个表情。Smiling appears to be universal across every culture.
sceneCN: 这里 universal 是「普遍的、人人都有的」（第 1 个义项：对所有人都成立）；句意为微笑似乎在所有文化中都是普遍的。罩住一切的那个圆顶，就是这个词的样子。

pos.zh: 普遍的；全体的；人人都有的
普遍概念；通用规律（哲学用法）

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ly 构成，义为「普遍地；人人皆然地」
由本词加 -ity 构成，义为「普遍性；通用性」
与本词同源，义为「宇宙；全体」
与本词同源，义为「大学」，原指师生的全体团体

senses.title: True of everyone
senses.definition: applying to or shared by all people or all things of a kind
senses.definitionCN: 适用于某类的所有人或所有事物，或为其所共有
senses.example: The desire for safety is universal among parents.
senses.exampleCN: 对安全的渴望在父母心中是普遍的。
senses.why: Unus is one and versus is turned towards one: the whole field is gathered into a single reach.
senses.whyCN: unus 是「一」，versus 是「朝向一个」：整片领域被收进同一个范围。

senses.title: Usable in all cases
senses.definition: designed to work or apply in every case, without special adjustment
senses.definitionCN: 无需特别调整即可在任何情形下使用或适用
senses.example: A universal charger saves travellers from carrying five cables.
senses.exampleCN: 一只通用充电器让旅客不必带五根线。
senses.why: The adjective extends from people to tools: one form that fits everything.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词从人扩展到工具：一种形式适合一切。

senses.title: Of the whole universe
senses.definition: relating to the whole of space and everything in it
senses.definitionCN: 与整个空间及其中的一切有关的
senses.example: Gravity is a universal force, acting on every mass in space.
senses.exampleCN: 引力是一种宇宙之力，作用于太空中的每个质量。
senses.why: In philosophy the word already meant the whole of things, and astronomy borrowed that reach.
senses.whyCN: 在哲学中这个词本已指万物的全体，天文学借用了这份范围。

senses.title: A general concept
senses.definition: in philosophy, a quality or concept said of many things rather than of one
senses.definitionCN: 哲学中指可被多个事物共有的性质或概念，而非单个事物
senses.example: Medieval thinkers argued about whether universals exist apart from things.
senses.exampleCN: 中世纪思想家争论普遍概念是否存在于事物之外。
senses.why: Logic needs a name for what many share, and the word for whole becomes that name.
senses.whyCN: 逻辑学需要为众多事物共有之物命名，表示「全体」的词就成了这个名字。

senses.title: Everyone, without exception
senses.titleCN: 全体一致的；无一例外的
senses.definition: in phrases such as universal approval, agreeing by all without a single objection
senses.definitionCN: 在 universal approval 等说法中，指全体同意、没有一票反对
senses.example: The new playground won universal approval at the meeting.
senses.exampleCN: 新游乐场在会上获得一致赞同。
senses.why: Here the word does not describe a law but counts people: nobody is left outside.
senses.whyCN: 这里这个词不描述规律而在数人：没有一个人被留在外面。

intro.en: Universal is built on the same Latin pair as universe: one, and turning towards one whole.
intro.cn: universal 与 universe 建立在同一对拉丁语词上：「一」，以及「转向同一整体」。

items.en: Unus meant one, and the verb vertere meant to turn; the pair gave universus, turned into one, whole.
items.cn: 拉丁语 unus 意为「一」，动词 vertere 意为「转动」；二者合出 universus，即「合成一个、整个的」。

items.en: Late Latin universalis meant belonging to all, and it was the adjective used in logic and law.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语 universalis 意为「属于全体的」，是逻辑学与法学里的形容词。

items.en: French universal carried the sense of general and applied to all cases.
items.cn: 法语 universal 带有「一般的、适用于一切情形」的意思。

items.en: Scholastic writers used universal for concepts shared by many things.
items.cn: 经院作者用 universal 指众多事物共有的概念。

items.en: Natural science took up the word for laws holding everywhere, and everyday speech took it for what everyone shares.
items.cn: 自然科学取它表示处处成立的定律，日常言语则取它表示人人共有之物。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words from the same one-and-turn root; the near-meaning group gathers adjectives of scope with different breadth.
note.cn: 形近组收同一「合一」词根上的词；近义组收表示范围的形容词，宽窄不同。

entries.definition: The adverb meaning by everyone or in every case.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「普遍地、人人皆然地」。

entries.definition: The noun for the quality of applying to all.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「普遍性、通用性」。

entries.definition: Everything that exists, literally turned into one.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「宇宙」，字面即「合为一体」。

entries.definition: A place of higher learning, once a whole community of scholars.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「大学」，原指学者的全体团体。

entries.definition: The belief that a principle holds for everyone everywhere.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「普遍主义」，认为某原则对天下所有人成立。

entries.definition: True in most cases but allowing exceptions; weaker than universal.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「一般的」，多数情形成立但允许例外，比 universal 弱。

entries.definition: Covering the whole world in space or reach.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「全球的」，指在空间或影响上覆盖整个世界。

entries.definition: Found over a large area or among many people, but not necessarily all.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「广泛的」，地域或人群范围大，但不一定涵盖全部。

entries.definition: Shared by many or occurring often; it makes no claim about everyone.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「共同的、常见的」，不主张对人人成立。

entries.definition: Broad in taste or interest, or universal in the older sense; formal and rare.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「广泛的、普遍的」，较正式而少见。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the two Latin pieces, one and turn, and the phrases the word really appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子使用两个拉丁部件「一」与「转」，以及这个词真正出现的搭配。

normal.en: Uni- is one and verse is to turn: turned into one, so everything is inside.
normal.cn: uni- 是「一」，verse 是「转」：转成一整个，所以一切都在里面。

normal.en: A universal truth holds for everyone, without exceptions.
normal.cn: 普遍真理对每人都成立，没有例外。

normal.en: A universal charger replaces a bag of cables.
normal.cn: 通用充电器能替掉一包线。

normal.en: University and universe share the root: one whole of students, one whole of things.
normal.cn: university 与 universe 共享词根：学生的整体，与万物的整体。

normal.en: Universal approval means not one hand stayed down.
normal.cn: 一致赞同意味着没有一只手没举起来。

abstract.en: Picture a dome wide enough to cover every town at once: whatever stands outside it is, by definition, an exception.
abstract.cn: 想象一个宽到能同时罩住每座城镇的圆顶：站在外面的事物按定义就是例外。

abstract.en: To call a rule universal is a strong claim; one counterexample is enough to break it.
abstract.cn: 称一条规律为普遍的是很强的断言：一个反例就足以打破它。

abstract.en: The word gathers a whole world into one turning point, which is why it can cover laws and people alike.
abstract.cn: 这个词把一整个世界收进同一个转折点，因此它既能盖住规律，也能盖住人。

examples.en: Music is often called a universal language.
examples.cn: 音乐常被称为一种通用语言。

examples.en: Access to clean water should be a universal right.
examples.cn: 获得干净的水应当是一项普遍权利。

examples.en: The plan met with universal support at the council meeting.
examples.cn: 这项计划在议会上得到了全体支持。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「优尼沃索」——优尼把沃索全部转进一个圈：普遍的、全体的

root: 源自拉丁语 unus「一」加 vertere「转动」构成的 universus「合成一个的、整个的」，晚期拉丁语 universalis「属于全体的」经法语进入英语；由「全体」引申出普遍、通用与宇宙等义。

sensesIntro.en: Five senses of universal all describe one reach: a whole gathered into one, whether it is all people, all cases, all of space, a shared concept, or a vote without exception.
sensesIntro.cn: universal 的五个义项都描述同一种覆盖：把整体收成一个，无论那是所有人、所有情形、整个空间、共有概念，还是无一例外的表决。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a vast dome that encloses every place and leaves nothing outside.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个巨大的圆顶罩住每一处，什么都不留在外面。

branches.en: THE PEOPLE: a feeling or truth shared by everyone.
branches.cn: 人群线：人人都共有的感受或真理。

branches.en: THE TOOL: one design that fits every case.
branches.cn: 工具线：一种设计适用于每一种情形。

branches.en: THE COSMOS: the reach extends to all of space.
branches.cn: 宇宙线：覆盖范围扩展到整个空间。

branches.en: THE CONCEPT: philosophy names what many things share.
branches.cn: 概念线：哲学为众多事物共有之物命名。

branches.en: THE VOTE: nobody is left outside the agreement.
branches.cn: 表决线：没有人被留在同意之外。

intro.en: Universal is a Latin compound plus an adjective ending, with English suffixes for its family.
intro.cn: universal 是一个拉丁语复合词加形容词词尾，家族成员用英语后缀构成。

latinIntro.en: Unus, vertere and universus are all recorded, and universalis is recorded in late Latin.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 unus、vertere、universus 均有记录，universalis 见于晚期拉丁语。

items.example: The prefix gathers everything into one.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀把一切收进一个。

items.example: The root gives the turning towards one.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根给出「转向一」的意思。
它把 universus 变成 universal。

definition_zh: 宇宙；万物；领域；范围；全体
definition_en: all of space and everything in it, or a particular area of interest or activity
core_image: 无数星点在一个不断向外膨胀的巨大黑暗球体里旋转，全部合成一个整体
scene: 天文台的圆顶在夜里滑开，望远镜对准一片几乎看不见的星云。Astronomers say the universe is still expanding today.
sceneCN: 这里 universe 是「宇宙」（第 1 个义项：整个空间及其中的一切）；句意为天文学家说宇宙如今仍在膨胀。全部星点合为一体的那一整片，就是这个词的样子。

derivatives.zh: 与本词同源，义为「普遍的；全体的」
由 universal 加 -ly 构成，义为「普遍地」
与本词同源，义为「大学」，原指学者的全体
由 univers 加 -ology 与 -ical 构成，义为「宇宙学的」

senses.title: All of space and matter
senses.definition: all of space and everything in it, taken as one whole
senses.definitionCN: 整个空间及其中的一切，被视为一个整体
senses.example: Light from the farthest galaxies has travelled most of the age of the universe.
senses.exampleCN: 最远星系的光已经走了宇宙年龄的大部分时间。
senses.why: Unus is one and versus is turned: all things turned into a single whole.
senses.whyCN: unus 是「一」，versus 是「转」：万物转成一个整体。

senses.title: A field of activity
senses.definition: a particular area of knowledge, activity, or interest with its own laws
senses.definitionCN: 具有自身规律的一个特定知识、活动或兴趣领域
senses.example: In the universe of small business, cash flow is the first rule.
senses.exampleCN: 在小型企业的领域里，现金流是第一法则。
senses.why: A field so large that it has its own laws is felt to be a whole, and the name for the whole is applied to it.
senses.whyCN: 一个大到有自身法则的范围会被感觉成一个整体，而表示整体的名称就被用到它身上。

senses.title: The whole set of something
senses.definition: the complete collection of a kind of thing, without exception
senses.definitionCN: 某一类事物的完整集合，没有例外
senses.example: The survey tried to cover the universe of public libraries in the country.
senses.exampleCN: 这项调查试图覆盖全国公共图书馆的全体。
senses.why: Counting every member and stopping at nothing gives the same total that the word first meant.
senses.whyCN: 把每个成员都数上而不留下任何例外，得到的就是这个词最初所指的那个总和。

senses.title: A group of people
senses.definition: a set of people with shared work or interests, such as the art world
senses.definitionCN: 因工作或兴趣相同而聚成的一群人，如艺术界
senses.example: Her paintings are well known inside the fashion universe.
senses.exampleCN: 她的画作在时尚圈里广为人知。
senses.why: People who share a trade form a closed circle, and a closed circle is a small universe of its own.
senses.whyCN: 同行的人形成一个封闭的圈子，而封闭的圈子本身就是一个小小的宇宙。

senses.title: A world of one's own
senses.definition: an imagined or invented world, as in a fictional or parallel universe
senses.definitionCN: 想象或虚构出来的世界，如小说世界或平行宇宙
senses.example: Every novel creates a small universe with its own weather and laws.
senses.exampleCN: 每部小说都创造出一个有自己的天气与法则的小世界。
senses.why: If a whole needs nothing outside itself, an invented one can be complete too, and the word is lent to fiction.
senses.whyCN: 如果一个整体无需外物即可自足，那么虚构的整体也可以完整，这个词便借给了小说。

intro.en: Universe comes straight from a Latin adjective meaning turned into one, and became a noun in French before English.
intro.cn: universe 直接来自一个意为「合成一个」的拉丁语形容词，在法语中先成为名词，再进入英语。

items.en: Unus meant one and vertere meant to turn; universus described many things turned into one whole.
items.cn: 拉丁语 unus 意为「一」，vertere 意为「转动」；universus 表示许多事物转成一个整体。

items.en: The neuter form universum was used as a noun for the whole of things.
items.cn: 其中性形式 universum 被用作名词，指万物的全体。

items.en: Old French univers took the noun for the totality of creation, and used it for a whole community as well.
items.cn: 古法语 univers 接纳了这个名词，指造物的全体，也用来指一个完整的团体。

items.en: English adopted universe for the whole of created things, earth and heavens together.
items.cn: 英语以 universe 指被造万物的全体，天地合在一起。

items.en: Astronomy redrew the word as all of space and time, and everyday speech borrowed it for any large field or circle.
items.cn: 天文学把这个词界定为整个空间与时间，日常言语又借它指任何大的领域或圈子。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words on the same one-and-turn root; the near-meaning group gathers words for totalities of different kinds.
note.cn: 形近组收同一「合一」词根上的词；近义组收表示不同类型整体的词。

entries.definition: The adjective meaning true of everyone or everything.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「普遍的、全体的」。

entries.definition: A place of higher learning; once a whole guild of scholars.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「大学」，原指学者的整个行会。

entries.definition: The adverb meaning by all or in every case.
The plural, used for imagined or parallel worlds.
entries.definitionCN: 复数形式，多用于虚构世界或平行宇宙。

entries.definition: Varied and unlike each other; it contains vers but no one.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「多样的」，含 vers 但不含「一」。

entries.definition: The universe seen as an ordered, harmonious whole.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「宇宙」，强调其有秩序的和谐整体。

entries.definition: All that exists, seen as made by a creator.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「造物、万物」，带有被创造的含义。

entries.definition: The earth and its people, or a particular sphere of life.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「世界」，也可指某个生活领域。

entries.definition: A kingdom or a distinct area of activity.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「领域、王国」，指一个独立的范围。

entries.definition: One of the large systems of stars; only a part of the universe.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「星系」，只是宇宙的一部分。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the Latin pieces of the word and the phrases it appears in today.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子使用这个词的拉丁部件，以及它今天常见的搭配。

normal.en: Uni- is one and verse is turn: the whole of things turned into one.
normal.cn: uni- 是「一」，verse 是「转」：万物转成一个。

normal.en: The universe is still expanding, so the word names something it cannot hold still.
normal.cn: 宇宙仍在膨胀，因此这个词命名的东西无法静止。

normal.en: University carries the same root: one whole community of scholars.
normal.cn: university 有同一词根：一整个学者的团体。

normal.en: A parallel universe is invented; the fashion universe is merely a large circle.
normal.cn: 平行宇宙是虚构的；时尚界只是一大圈人。

normal.en: The universe of libraries means every library, counted together.
normal.cn: 图书馆的全体指把所有图书馆加在一起。

abstract.en: Picture every star turned towards one centre: the word started as an act of gathering, not a place.
abstract.cn: 想象所有星辰都朝向同一个中心：这个词起初是收拢的动作，而不是一个地点。

abstract.en: Any field large enough to have its own rules gets called a universe, because it is whole inside itself.
abstract.cn: 任何大到有自己规则的领域都会被称作一个宇宙，因为它在内部自成整体。

abstract.en: The word is an answer to a question: what is there, if you count everything at once.
abstract.cn: 这个词回答的是一个问题：如果把所有东西一次数完，那里有什么。

examples.en: Scientists still argue about how the universe began.
examples.cn: 科学家们仍在争论宇宙是如何开始的。

examples.en: In the universe of online shops, speed of delivery decides everything.
examples.cn: 在网络商店这个领域里，送货速度决定一切。

examples.en: The novel builds a universe where people can hear each other's thoughts.
examples.cn: 这部小说构建了一个人们能听见彼此心思的世界。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「优尼沃斯」——优尼把沃斯整个转成一团：宇宙、全体

root: 源自拉丁语 unus「一」加 vertere「转动」构成的 universus「合成一个的、整个的」，其中性形式 universum 作名词指万物全体，经古法语 univers 进入英语，近代天文学用来指整个空间与时间。

sensesIntro.en: Five senses of universe all name a whole gathered into one: all of space, a field with its own rules, a complete set, a circle of people, or an imagined world.
sensesIntro.cn: universe 的五个义项都在命名被收成一个的整体：整个空间、自成一体的领域、完整的集合、一圈人，或虚构的世界。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: countless stars turning inside one vast sphere of darkness.
core.cn: 核心意象：无数星点在同一个巨大黑暗球体里旋转。

branches.en: THE COSMOS: space and every object in it, taken together.
branches.cn: 宇宙线：空间及其中的每一个物体，合在一起。

branches.en: THE FIELD: one area of activity with its own rules.
branches.cn: 领域线：一个有自身规则的特定活动范围。

branches.en: THE SET: every member of a kind, without exception.
branches.cn: 集合线：某一类里的每个成员，没有例外。

branches.en: THE CIRCLE: a group of people who share a world.
branches.cn: 圈子线：共享同一个世界的一群人。

branches.en: THE INVENTION: fiction builds small universes of its own.
branches.cn: 虚构线：小说造出自己的一方小宇宙。

intro.en: Universe is a two-piece Latin compound, and the rest of its family is made with English suffixes.
intro.cn: universe 是两段组成的拉丁语复合词，家族其余成员由英语后缀构成。

latinIntro.en: Unus, vertere and universus are all recorded, and universum appears as a noun in Latin.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 unus、vertere、universus 均有记录，universum 在拉丁语中作名词使用。

items.example: It closes the Latin adjective into a noun.
items.exampleCN: 它把拉丁语形容词收成名词。

definition_zh: 大学；综合性大学；大学校园
definition_en: a large school for higher education where students study for degrees and research is done
core_image: 一片古老的院落里，几栋教学楼、图书馆与宿舍围成一圈，学生抱着书穿过草坪
scene: 九月清晨，新生拖着箱子在门口停下，抬头看着门楣上刻着校名的石碑。She chose this university because of its astronomy department.
sceneCN: 这里 university 是「大学」（第 1 个义项：授予学位并进行研究的高等学校）；句意为她因为天文系而选择了这所大学。门口刻着校名的那片院落，就是这个词的样子。

pos.zh: 大学全体师生（集合用法）

derivatives.zh: 与本词同源，义为「普遍的；全体的」
与本词同源，义为「宇宙；全体」
由本词加 -arian 构成，义为「大学的；大学成员的」
由 inter- 加本词构成，义为「校际的」

senses.title: A place that grants degrees
senses.definition: an institution for higher education that awards degrees and carries out research
senses.definitionCN: 授予学位并进行研究的高等教育机构
senses.example: She teaches chemistry at a university in the north.
senses.exampleCN: 她在北方的一所大学教化学。
senses.why: Universitas first meant any whole body of people; the guild of teachers and students became this kind of school.
senses.whyCN: universitas 最初指任何一个人的整体；教师与学生的行会后来成了这种学校。

senses.title: The buildings and grounds
senses.definition: the buildings and grounds of such an institution, taken as a place
senses.definitionCN: 这样一所机构的建筑与场地，被当作一个地方
senses.example: The whole university was quiet during the summer holidays.
senses.exampleCN: 暑假期间整个校园都很安静。
senses.why: The abstract body of scholars became a physical place on a map.
senses.whyCN: 抽象的学者团体变成了地图上一个实在的地方。

senses.title: Its members together
senses.definition: all the students and teachers of the institution as a single community
senses.definitionCN: 把一所院校的学生与教师视为一个共同体
senses.example: The university voted to change the name of its main hall.
senses.exampleCN: 全校投票决定更改主楼的名字。
senses.why: The oldest sense survives: a university is still a group of people, not only walls.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的意义仍在：大学仍然是一群人，而不只是墙。

senses.title: The idea of higher learning
senses.definition: used generally of higher education as a stage of life or a system
senses.definitionCN: 泛指高等教育这一阶段或这一体系
senses.example: Going to university changes how a young person reads the world.
senses.exampleCN: 上大学会改变一个年轻人看世界的方式。
senses.why: British usage leaves out the article to name the stage itself rather than a building.
senses.whyCN: 英式用法省略冠词，指的是这个阶段本身而不是一栋建筑。

senses.title: Life as a school
senses.definition: in fixed phrases such as the university of life, experience treated as an education
senses.definitionCN: 用于 the university of life 等固定说法，把经历当作一种教育
senses.example: He never finished school, but the university of life taught him plenty.
senses.exampleCN: 他没有念完书，但社会这所大学教了他很多。
senses.why: The word becomes a metaphor: anything that teaches at length is granted its name.
senses.whyCN: 这个词成了比喻：凡是长期教人的东西都被赋予它的名字。

intro.en: University began as a Latin word for any whole body of people, and narrowed to the guild of scholars.
intro.cn: university 起初是拉丁语里指任何人的整体的词，后来收窄为学者的行会。

items.en: Universus meant turned into one, whole, and universitas meant the whole of a group.
items.cn: 拉丁语 universus 意为「合成一个的、整个的」，universitas 意为「一个团体的全体」。

items.en: In the Middle Ages universitas was used for any guild or corporation, including that of teachers and students.
items.cn: 中世纪时 universitas 可指任何行会或法人团体，也包括教师与学生的行会。

items.en: French université was applied specifically to the scholars' guild and the school it ran.
items.cn: 法语 université 专门用来指学者的行会及其所办的学校。

items.en: English took university in the fourteenth century for a school of higher learning with its own rules.
items.cn: 英语在十四世纪以 university 指有自身规章的高等学校。

items.en: The word spread with modern degree systems, and British usage dropped the article in go to university.
items.cn: 随着现代学位制度普及，这个词流传开来，英式用法在 go to university 中省略了冠词。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words on the same whole-body root; the near-meaning group gathers names for institutions of learning.
note.cn: 形近组收同一「整体」词根上的词；近义组收各类教育机构的名称。

entries.definition: The adjective for what applies to all.
All of space and matter; the root word of the family.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「宇宙」，是这一词族的根词。

entries.definition: The quality of holding for everyone.
The plural, used for several institutions.
Variety and difference; close in sound but built on another root.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「多样性」，读音相近但词根不同。

entries.definition: A smaller institution or a part of a university; often grants diplomas.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「学院」，规模较小或是大学的一部分。

entries.definition: A school for a special field, or a learned society.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「专科院校、学会」，多用于特定领域。

entries.definition: An organization for research or teaching in one field.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「学院、研究所」，多指某一领域的研究或教学机构。

entries.definition: A school for technical and applied subjects; in Britain often now a university.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「理工学院」，在英国如今多已成为大学。

entries.definition: A general word for any place of teaching, including primary ones.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「学校」，泛指任何教学场所，包括小学。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the old sense of a whole body of people and the phrases the word appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子使用这个词「一群人的整体」的古老意义，以及它常见的搭配。

normal.en: Universitas meant any whole guild: a university is still a whole body of teachers and students.
normal.cn: universitas 指任何完整的行会：大学仍是教师与学生的整体。

normal.en: In British English people say go to university with no article.
normal.cn: 英式英语说 go to university，不加冠词。

normal.en: University student, university degree, university entrance: the word mainly works as an attributive.
normal.cn: university student、university degree、university entrance：这个词多作定语。

normal.en: The plural is universities, with the y turned to ie.
normal.cn: 复数是 universities，y 变为 ie。

normal.en: The university of life is a school without walls.
normal.cn: the university of life 是一所没有围墙的学校。

abstract.en: Picture a gate carved with a name: everyone who walks through becomes part of one body.
abstract.cn: 想象镌刻着校名的大门：走进来的人都成为一个整体的一部分。

abstract.en: The building and the community share one word, because the oldest sense is the people, not the stones.
abstract.cn: 建筑与共同体共用同一个词，因为最古老的意义是人而不是石头。

abstract.en: A university is a place that keeps knowledge alive by passing it on.
abstract.cn: 大学是一个靠传递而让知识活下来的地方。

examples.en: He studied law at a university in Beijing.
examples.cn: 他在北京的一所大学读法律。

examples.en: Most students live on campus during their first year at university.
examples.cn: 多数学生上大学的头一年住在校内。

examples.en: The university has three libraries and a small museum.
examples.cn: 这所大学有三个图书馆和一座小博物馆。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「优尼沃西提」——优尼沃西一提校名，人人都成了整体：大学

root: 源自拉丁语 universus「合成一个的、整个的」所生的 universitas「团体的全体」，中世纪指任何行会，包括师生行会；经古法语 université 进入英语，专指有自身规章的高等学校。

sensesIntro.en: Five senses of university all rest on one old idea: a whole body of people. That body became a school, then a place, then a stage of life, then a metaphor.
sensesIntro.cn: university 的五个义项都立在一个古老观念上：一群人的整体。这个整体成了学校，又成了地方、人生阶段，最后成了比喻。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a ring of old buildings around a lawn, with a carved name above the gate.
core.cn: 核心意象：一片古老建筑围着草坪，门楣上刻着校名。

branches.en: THE SCHOOL: the guild became an institution that grants degrees.
branches.cn: 学校线：行会变成了授予学位的机构。

branches.en: THE PLACE: the institution has walls, lawns and libraries.
branches.cn: 地点线：这所机构有墙、草坪与图书馆。

branches.en: THE MEMBERS: the oldest sense, all its students and teachers together.
branches.cn: 成员线：最古老的意义，全体师生合在一起。

branches.en: THE STAGE: going to university names a period of life.
branches.cn: 阶段线：上大学指的是人生的一段时期。

branches.en: THE METAPHOR: any long teacher is granted the name.
branches.cn: 比喻线：任何长期的教导者都被赋予这个名字。

intro.en: University is a Latin compound with the Latin suffix -tas, which becomes -ty in English.
intro.cn: university 是带拉丁语后缀 -tas 的复合词，该后缀在英语中变为 -ty。

latinIntro.en: Universus and universitas are both recorded, and the suffix -tas is the standard Latin way to make a noun of quality.
latinIntro.cn: universus 与 universitas 均有记录，-tas 是拉丁语构成性质名词的标准后缀。

items.example: The prefix gathers the group into one.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀把人群收成一个。

items.example: The root gives the turning to one side.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根给出朝向一边转的意思。
它把 universitas 变成 university。

items.meaning: the whole of a body, a guild

items.example: The sense that produced the school.
items.exampleCN: 生出了这种学校的那个义项。

latinEntries.meaning: the whole of a body, a guild

definition_zh: 未知的；不著名的；陌生的；未知的事物；无名者
definition_en: not known, not identified, or not famous, or a person or thing that is not known
core_image: 一张地图的边缘渐渐变淡，最后化成一片没有标注的空白，只写着「未探明」
scene: 侦探把照片翻过来，背面没有一个字，只有一枚模糊的指纹。The identity of the caller remains unknown.
sceneCN: 这里 unknown 是「未知的、不为人知的」（第 1 个义项：尚不被知道）；句意为来电者的身份仍然不明。地图上那片没被标注的空白，就是这个词的样子。

derivatives.zh: 由古英语 uncuð 一类形式经 know 加 -able 构成，义为「不可知的」
由 unknown 的词干加 -ingly 构成，义为「不知不觉地」
本词的复数，义为「若干未知因素」
本词去掉 un-，义为「已知的；著名的」

senses.title: Not known at all
senses.definition: not known to anyone, or not yet discovered or understood
senses.definitionCN: 尚不为人所知，或尚未被发现与理解
senses.example: The cause of the fire is still unknown.
senses.exampleCN: 起火的原因仍不清楚。
senses.why: Un- denies and know supplies the knowing: the fact has not been reached by any mind.
senses.whyCN: un- 表示否定，know 提供「知道」：这个事实还没有被任何头脑触及。

senses.title: Not identified
senses.definition: not recognized or identified, as of a person, a name, or a source
senses.definitionCN: 不能辨认或确认，如某个人、某个名字或某个来源
senses.example: Police are searching for an unknown man seen near the bank.
senses.exampleCN: 警方正在寻找一名在银行附近被看到的身份不明男子。
senses.why: Here the thing exists but its label is missing; the gap is in identification.
senses.whyCN: 这里事物存在，缺的是标签；空缺在身份辨认上。

senses.title: Not famous
senses.definition: not well known to the public, though perhaps respected by a few
senses.definitionCN: 不为公众所知，虽然可能被少数人看重
senses.example: The painting was bought for a small sum from an unknown artist.
senses.exampleCN: 这幅画以很低的价钱从一位不出名的画家那里买来。
senses.why: Reputation is a kind of knowing held by many; if few know you, you are unknown.
senses.whyCN: 名声是许多人所持有的一种知道；知道你的少，你就是不为人知。

senses.title: The unknown as a whole
senses.definition: with the, the part of the world or of knowledge not yet explored or understood
senses.definitionCN: 与 the 连用，指世界或知识中尚未被探索与理解的部分
senses.example: Explorers in those years were drawn to the unknown.
senses.exampleCN: 那些年的探险者被未知吸引。
senses.why: An adjective of state becomes a noun for the whole region no one has entered.
senses.whyCN: 表示状态的形容词转成了名词，指没人进入过的那一整片区域。

senses.title: A person without a name
senses.definition: with a, someone whose name is not known, as in an unknown soldier
senses.definitionCN: 与 a 连用，指名字不为所知的人，如无名战士
senses.example: A stone in the square honours the unknown who fell in the war.
senses.exampleCN: 广场上的一块石头纪念战争中阵亡的无名者。
senses.why: The word names the person by what is missing, which is why it can honour them.
senses.whyCN: 这个词以「缺少的东西」来命名人，因此它能够用来致敬。

intro.en: Unknown began as a native Old English compound and has kept the same shape for a thousand years.
intro.cn: unknown 起初是古英语本土复合词，一千年来形式几乎未变。

items.en: Un- denied and cnāwan meant to know; the compound uncūþ covered what was not known.
items.cn: un- 是否定前缀，cnāwan 意为「知道」；复合词 uncūþ 指所不知道的事物。

items.en: Norse influence helped know and its forms settle as the everyday words of England.
items.cn: 诺尔斯语影响使 know 及其种种形式成为英格兰日常用语。

items.en: The form settled as unknow(e)n, spelled closer to the modern word.
items.cn: 中古英语中形式固定为 unknow(e)n，拼写接近现代。

items.en: The word spread from facts to people, becoming a title for the anonymous, as in the unknown soldier.
items.cn: 这个词从事实扩展到人，成为无名者的称谓，如无名战士。

items.en: Science and mathematics made the noun common, as in unknowns in an equation.
items.cn: 科学与数学使名词用法普及，如方程中的未知数。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers other words in un- and forms of know; the near-meaning group gathers adjectives for what is not familiar or not certain.
note.cn: 形近组收其他以 un- 构成的词以及 know 的各种形式；近义组收表示不熟悉或不确定的形容词。

entries.definition: The adjective for what is recognized or widely known.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「已知的、著名的」，与本词相反。

entries.definition: Beyond any possibility of being known.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「不可知的」，根本无从得知。

entries.definition: Without being aware of it; the word describes a person's action.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「不知不觉地」，描述人的行为。

entries.definition: Not known because not met before; it stresses lack of acquaintance.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「不熟悉的」，强调没有接触过。

entries.definition: Going without being seen or heeded.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「未被注意到的」。

entries.definition: Not easy to understand; the facts exist but are dim.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「不清楚的」，事实存在但模糊。

entries.definition: Of a person whose name is not given; formal and common in writing.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「匿名的」，较正式，多用于书面。

entries.definition: Little known, or hard to see; often used of writers and words.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「鲜为人知的、晦涩的」，多用于作者与词语。

entries.definition: Not settled or sure; it describes doubt rather than absence of knowledge.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「不确定的」，描述怀疑而非知识的缺失。

entries.definition: Strange and hard to explain, often with a feeling of secrecy.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「神秘的」，带有秘密的气氛。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the plain un- plus know structure and the phrases the word appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子使用 un 加 know 的朴素结构，以及这个词常用的搭配。

normal.en: Un- means not and know is to know: literally not known.
normal.cn: un- 表示「不」，know 是「知道」：字面就是不被知道。

normal.en: Unknown to me means I was never told.
normal.cn: unknown to me 意为从来没人告诉过我。

normal.en: The unknown soldier is honoured precisely because his name is missing.
normal.cn: 无名战士之所以受纪念，恰恰因为名字缺失。

normal.en: In an equation the unknowns are the letters you must solve for.
normal.cn: 方程中的未知数就是你要解出的那些字母。

normal.en: The opposite is simply known.
normal.cn: 其反面就是 known。

abstract.en: Picture the edge of an old map fading into blank paper: what is missing is not nothing, but unwritten space.
abstract.cn: 想象旧地图的边缘淡成空白纸：缺的不是「没有」，而是尚未写下的空间。

abstract.en: Unknown is a word about the limits of a mind, not about the thing itself.
abstract.cn: unknown 说的是头脑的界限，而不是事物本身。

abstract.en: Every discovery begins as an unknown that nobody had yet named.
abstract.cn: 每一项发现最初都是一个还没人命名过的未知。

examples.en: The exact number of birds on the island is unknown.
examples.cn: 岛上鸟的确切数量未知。

examples.en: An unknown woman returned the lost wallet to the desk.
examples.cn: 一位不知名的女子把丢失的钱包交到了前台。

examples.en: They set out into the unknown with three weeks of food.
examples.cn: 他们带着三周的食物走向未知。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「安的弄恩」——安对此弄不明白，全然不知：未知的

root: 由否定前缀 un- 与古英语动词 cnāwan「知道」（今 know）构成，古英语作 uncūþ，中古英语写作 unknow(e)n；由「不被知道」扩展到身份不明、不出名，并名词化为未知之物与无名者。

sensesIntro.en: Five senses of unknown all mark a gap in knowing: a fact not reached, a face not identified, a name not famous, a region unexplored, or a person without a name.
sensesIntro.cn: unknown 的五个义项都标记认知上的空缺：未被触及的事实、未被辨认的面孔、不出名的名字、未被探索的区域，或没有名字的人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the edge of a map fading into blank paper with nothing written there.
core.cn: 核心意象：地图边缘淡成白纸，上面什么都没有写。

branches.en: THE FACT: something true that nobody has found out yet.
branches.cn: 事实线：确实存在却还没人查明的事情。

branches.en: THE FACE: the person is present, the identity is missing.
branches.cn: 面孔线：人在那里，身份却是空白。

branches.en: THE NAME: few people know him, though he may deserve it.
branches.cn: 名字线：知道他的人很少，尽管他可能值得被知道。

branches.en: THE REGION: the noun names the whole unexplored part.
branches.cn: 区域线：名词化后指整片未被探索之处。

branches.en: THE UNNAMED: honouring those whose names were never recorded.
branches.cn: 无名线：用来致敬那些名字从未被记下的人。

intro.en: Unknown is entirely native: a Germanic negative prefix on an Old English verb, with no Latin element at all.
intro.cn: unknown 完全是本土构造：日耳曼语否定前缀加古英语动词，不含任何拉丁成分。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin in this word; the table lists later Latin-based synonyms that cover the same gap.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词里没有拉丁成分；下表列出后世以拉丁语为源、指同样空缺的近义词。

items.example: The verb supplies the act that is missing.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词提供缺失的那个动作。

items.example: The older native form of know.
The oldest recorded form of the word.
items.exampleCN: 这个词最古老的记录形式。
一个正式的拉丁语来源近义词。

definition_zh: 除非；如果不；除非在……情况下
definition_en: except if; used to say that something will happen only if another thing does not happen
core_image: 一个岔路口立着一块牌子：除非走左边，否则到不了目的地；右边是一条被挡住的路
scene: 教练在雨天早晨对队员说，只有雨停才训练，否则全体在馆里看录像。We will not play outside unless the rain stops by noon.
sceneCN: 这里 unless 是「除非」（第 1 个义项：表示只有在某条件不成立时才发生）；句意为除非中午前雨停，否则我们不在外面踢球。路口那块牌子划出的唯一通路，就是这个词的样子。

pos.zh: 除非；如果不（引导条件从句）
除……之外（少见，多见于书面）
除非在……的情况下（与 not 连用表双重否定）

collocations.zh: 除非……否则什么也不会发生

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ed 构成，义为「带 unless 从句的」
由古英语 þy læs þe 缩合而成，义为「以免」，是 unless 的老近亲
与本词同源，义为「较少的」，构成 unless 的后半

senses.title: Except if
senses.definition: except if; a condition that alone can change the result
senses.definitionCN: 「除非」；唯一能够改变结果的那个条件
senses.example: You cannot enter unless you show your ticket.
senses.exampleCN: 除非出示门票，否则你不能进场。
senses.why: Unless is a compressed on less: the case you name is the single exception to the statement.
senses.whyCN: unless 是 on less 的压缩：你提出的那种情形是对这句话的唯一例外。

senses.title: Only in that case
senses.definition: used after a negative or in a question to mean only if
senses.definitionCN: 用于否定句或疑问句之后，意为「只有在……才」
senses.example: I will not agree unless the whole plan is explained first.
senses.exampleCN: 除非先把整个计划解释清楚，否则我不会同意。
senses.why: With not in front, the exception becomes the one door left open.
senses.whyCN: 前面加了 not，这个例外就成了唯一还开着的门。

senses.title: Except for
senses.definition: in older or formal prose, except for a thing just mentioned
senses.definitionCN: 在较早或正式的书面语中，指「除了刚提到的某物」
senses.example: Nothing was left of the house unless the stone steps.
senses.exampleCN: 除了那几级石阶，这座房子什么也没有剩下。
senses.why: The very old prepositional use keeps the plain sense of less as leaving something out.
senses.whyCN: 很古老的介词用法保留着 less「除去」的朴素含义。

senses.title: In fixed legal phrases
senses.definition: in clauses such as unless otherwise stated, the rule applies except where noted
senses.definitionCN: 在 unless otherwise stated 一类条款中，表示除注明处之外规则一律适用
senses.example: The fee is paid yearly unless otherwise agreed in writing.
senses.exampleCN: 除非另有书面约定，费用按年支付。
senses.why: Contracts need a single word for the written exception, and this is that word.
senses.whyCN: 合同需要一个词专门表示书面的例外，用的就是这个词。

senses.title: Doubled for emphasis
senses.definition: in the phrase unless and until, meaning not before at the earliest
senses.definitionCN: 在 unless and until 这一说法中，意为「最早也要到……才行」
senses.example: The office stays closed unless and until the roof is repaired.
senses.exampleCN: 除非并且直到屋顶修好，办公室才会重新开放。
senses.why: Two limiters side by side make the condition sound impossible to soften.
senses.whyCN: 两个限定词并排，让这个条件听起来无从通融。

intro.en: Unless is a worn-down phrase rather than a word built from parts: on less, meaning on a lesser condition.
intro.cn: unless 不是由词缀构成，而是一个磨短了的短语：on less，意为「在较小的条件下」。

items.en: The preposition on and the comparative lǣssa, less, stood side by side as on lǣssan, on a lesser condition.
items.cn: 介词 on 与比较级 lǣssa（较少）并列为 on lǣssan，意为「在较小的条件下」。

items.en: The phrase shrank to on lesse and then to unless, losing the space and then the o.
items.cn: 这个短语缩为 on lesse，再缩为 unless，先丢了空格，又丢了 o。

items.en: By the fourteenth century unless was used as a conjunction before a clause.
items.cn: 到十四世纪，unless 已用作引导从句的连词。

items.en: Lest, from a parallel phrase, kept the older meaning of avoiding something, and the two words divided the work.
items.cn: 由类似短语来的 lest 保留了「以免」的旧义，两个词于是各司其职。

items.en: Modern contracts fixed unless otherwise stated as a standard clause formula.
items.cn: 现代合同把 unless otherwise stated 固化为标准条款用语。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers negatives and near forms in un- or less; the near-meaning group gathers conjunctions of condition that differ in strength.
note.cn: 形近组收以 un- 或 less 构成的否定词与近形词；近义组收表示条件的连词，力度不同。

entries.definition: Up to the time that; it names a moment, not a condition.
entries.definitionCN: 连词，义为「直到」，指时间点而非条件。

entries.definition: About, regarding; close in sound to the old prepositional use only.
For fear that; the older partner of unless.
entries.definitionCN: 连词，义为「以免」，是 unless 较早的搭档词。

entries.definition: In spite of that; it contains less but means despite, not except.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「然而、不过」，含 less 但意为转折而非例外。

entries.definition: Nevertheless; it contains less but means in spite of that.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「尽管如此」，含 less 但意义不同。

entries.definition: The plain conditional with a negative; unless is its compressed form.
entries.definitionCN: 短语，义为「如果不」，unless 是其压缩形式。

entries.definition: The full phrase behind unless, still used in careful speech.
entries.definitionCN: 短语，义为「除非」，是 unless 的完整说法。

entries.definition: Only on the condition that; it states the condition positively.
entries.definitionCN: 连词短语，义为「只要」，从正面提出条件。

entries.definition: If not, or in other circumstances; often pairs with unless in clauses.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「否则」，常与 unless 在条款中配合使用。

entries.definition: As a precaution because something might happen; not the same as unless.
entries.definitionCN: 连词短语，义为「以防」，与 unless 不同。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the worn-down on less behind the word and the clauses it appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子使用这个词背后磨短的 on less，以及它常出现的从句。

normal.en: Unless is on less in disguise: the one case on a lesser footing, the exception.
normal.cn: unless 是 on less 的变形：那个处于次要地位的唯一情形，就是例外。

normal.en: Unless you show your ticket, you cannot enter: the exception is the only open door.
normal.cn: unless you show your ticket 意为除非出示门票；例外就是唯一开着的门。

normal.en: Unless otherwise stated is the standard formula in contracts.
normal.cn: unless otherwise stated 是合同里的标准说法。

normal.en: Do not confuse unless with until: one is a condition, the other a time.
normal.cn: 不要把 unless 与 until 混用：一个是条件，一个是时间。

normal.en: Lest and unless once did the same work.
normal.cn: lest 与 unless 曾做同一份工作。

abstract.en: Picture a road with a single gate: unless is the gate, and nothing else lets you through.
abstract.cn: 想象一条只有一道门的路：unless 就是那道门，别的都通不过。

abstract.en: The word thinks in negatives: it names the only thing that can stop the statement from being true.
abstract.cn: 这个词用否定来思考：它指出唯一能让这句话不成立的事。

abstract.en: Every rule has a unless hidden in it, which is why contracts love the word.
abstract.cn: 每条规则里都藏着一个 unless，所以合同喜欢这个词。

examples.en: Do not call me unless it is urgent.
examples.cn: 除非有急事，否则别打电话给我。

examples.en: The meeting will go ahead unless the storm gets worse.
examples.cn: 除非暴风雨加剧，会议照常举行。

examples.en: Unless otherwise stated, all prices include tax.
examples.cn: 除非另有说明，所有价格均含税。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「安的莱斯」——安说：除非莱斯先来，否则不开始：除非

root: 由中古英语短语 on lesse（在较小的条件下）缩合而成，源自 on 与比较级 lǣssa（较少）；十四世纪起作连词，与 lest 分工，现代又在合同里固定为 except 条件的标准说法。

sensesIntro.en: Five senses of unless all name the one exception: the only case where the statement fails, whether spoken as a condition, a negative clause, an old preposition, a contract formula, or a doubled limiter.
sensesIntro.cn: unless 的五个义项都指那唯一的例外：这句话唯一不成立的情形，表现为条件、否定从句、古老介词、合同套语或叠用的限定。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a single open gate on an otherwise blocked road.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条被挡住的路上一道唯一开着的门。

branches.en: THE EXCEPTION: the named case alone changes what happens.
branches.cn: 例外线：只有被点出的那种情形改变结果。

branches.en: THE NEGATIVE: after not, the exception becomes the only way in.
branches.cn: 否定线：在 not 之后，例外成了唯一的进路。

branches.en: THE OLD PREPOSITION: except for a thing, in older prose.
branches.cn: 旧介词线：在较早的书面语中表示「除某物之外」。

branches.en: THE CONTRACT: written rules need a word for the noted exception.
branches.cn: 合同线：书面规则需要一个词表示注明的例外。

branches.en: THE DOUBLE LIMIT: unless and until leaves no room to soften.
branches.cn: 双限线：unless and until 不给任何通融余地。

intro.en: This word has no affixes at all: it is a phrase worn down to six letters.
intro.cn: 这个词完全没有词缀：它是一个被磨短到六个字母的短语。

latinIntro.en: Nothing here is Latin; under this word sit the preposition on and an old comparative meaning less.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁成分；这个词底下是介词 on 与一个意为「较少」的古老比较级。

items.example: It survives only as the hidden first sound.
items.exampleCN: 它只作为隐藏的第一个音留存。

items.example: It is the modern shape of lǣssa.
items.exampleCN: 它是 lǣssa 的现代形式。

items.example: The comparative inside the old phrase.
items.exampleCN: 旧短语里的那个比较级。

items.example: A parallel contraction from þy læs þe.
items.exampleCN: 由 þy læs þe 并行的缩合词。

items.example: A look-alike that keeps less visible.
items.exampleCN: 一个把 less 留在表面的形近词。

items.example: The final form of on lesse.
Two limiters side by side in legal English.
items.exampleCN: 法律英语中并排使用的两个限定词。

definition_zh: 不像；与……不同；和……不一样；（作形容词）不同的；不相像的
definition_en: different from, not similar to, or in contrast to someone or something
core_image: 两枚并排放着的贝壳：一枚细长有纹，一枚扁圆光滑，一眼就看得出不是一家
scene: 姐姐安静地读书，弟弟却一整天都在院子里拆东西，母亲常对客人说他们是完全不同的人。Unlike her brother, she has never broken a single cup.
sceneCN: 这里 unlike 是「与……不同、不像」（第 1 个义项：表示对比）；句意为和弟弟不同，她从未打碎过一只杯子。两枚并排放着却毫不相像的贝壳，就是这个词的样子。

pos.zh: 不典型的；不像平常那样的
不像……那样（非标准，口语偶见）

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ly 构成，义为「不太可能的」
由本词加 -ness 构成，义为「不相似、不同」
本词去掉 un-，义为「像；如同」
与本词同源，义为「相似的」，多作表语

senses.title: Different from
senses.definition: used to say that one person or thing is different from another
senses.definitionCN: 用来表示某个人或物与另一个不同
senses.example: Unlike his father, he has never enjoyed fishing.
senses.exampleCN: 与他父亲不同，他从来不喜欢钓鱼。
senses.why: The prefix denies likeness while still setting the two people side by side, so the comparison stays visible.
senses.whyCN: 这个前缀否认相像，却仍把两个人并排放着，比较因此看得见。

senses.title: Not similar to in kind
senses.titleCN: 不相像的；不类似的（形容词）
senses.definition: not similar in appearance, character, or nature
senses.definitionCN: 在外观、性格或性质上不相像
senses.example: The two sisters are unlike in almost every way.
senses.exampleCN: 这对姐妹几乎在各方面都不相像。
senses.why: As an adjective the same word drops the second person and simply denies sameness in nature.
senses.whyCN: 作形容词时，同一个词不再针对第二个对象，只是单纯否认性质上的相同。

senses.title: Not like the usual
senses.definition: not typical of a person, so that it surprises those who know them
senses.definitionCN: 不像某人平时那样，因而让熟悉的人感到意外
senses.example: It is unlike her to arrive so late.
senses.exampleCN: 迟到这么久不像她的作风。
senses.why: The comparison is now between a person and their own usual self, which is why the word can sound like surprise.
senses.whyCN: 比较发生在一个人与自己平日的模样之间，因此这个词听起来带着惊讶。

senses.title: To point at a contrast
senses.definition: at the start of a clause, drawing a contrast with what follows
senses.definitionCN: 用于从句开头，与后文形成对比
senses.example: Unlike other cities, this one keeps its trams in the centre.
senses.exampleCN: 与别的城市不同，这座城市把有轨电车保留在市中心。
senses.why: At the head of a clause the preposition sets the second half of the sentence against the first.
senses.whyCN: 放在从句开头时，这个介词把句子的后半段与前半段对立起来。

senses.title: Unlike anything else
senses.definition: in the phrase unlike anything, stressing that no comparison is possible
senses.definitionCN: 在 unlike anything 这一说法中，强调无从比较
senses.example: The storm was unlike anything the village had seen.
senses.exampleCN: 这场风暴是村里人从未见过的。
senses.why: When the second term is anything, the comparison is denied altogether: nothing matches.
senses.whyCN: 当比较的另一项是 anything 时，比较被彻底取消：没有任何东西能相配。

intro.en: Unlike is the native negative prefix on an Old English word for what is like or alike.
intro.cn: unlike 是本土否定前缀加一个古英语表示「相似」的词。

items.en: Gelīc meant of the same form or body, from līc, a body; it became the modern like and alike.
items.cn: 古英语 gelīc 意为「形体相同的」，源于 līc（身体）；后演变为 like 与 alike。

items.en: The prefix un- was already used to deny such adjectives, as in ungelīc.
items.cn: 否定前缀 un- 早已用来否定这类形容词，如 ungelīc。

items.en: The word settled as unlike, and was used both as adjective and as preposition.
items.cn: 这个词固定为 unlike，既可作形容词也可作介词。

items.en: Unlike at the head of a clause became the standard way to open a contrast in written English.
items.cn: 在书面英语中，用 unlike 开头引出对比成了标准做法。

items.en: The derived unlikely took over the sense of not probable, leaving unlike to comparison alone.
items.cn: 派生词 unlikely 承担了「不太可能」的意思，unlike 则只保留比较义。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words in un- and like-alike forms; the near-meaning group gathers ways to mark contrast.
note.cn: 形近组收 un- 与 like、alike 一族的词；近义组收表示对比的说法。

entries.definition: Not probable; it points to chance rather than similarity.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「不太可能的」，指机会而不指相似。

entries.definition: The noun for the state of being different.
Similar to, or in the same way as; the word without un-.
entries.definitionCN: 介词，义为「像」，即去掉 un- 的词。

entries.definition: Similar to each other; usually after the verb be.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「相似的」，多作表语。

entries.definition: To not like something; close in shape but about feeling, not similarity.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「不喜欢」，形近而意义不同。

entries.definition: The plain and safest comparative phrase in formal writing.
entries.definitionCN: 短语，义为「与……不同」，正式写作中最稳妥。

entries.definition: Marks a sharp difference; more formal and heavier than unlike.
entries.definitionCN: 短语，义为「与……形成对比」，较正式。

entries.definition: Used to turn the sentence towards an opposite case.
entries.definitionCN: 短语，义为「相比之下」，用于转向相反的情形。

entries.definition: A conjunction joining two contrasted clauses in one sentence.
entries.definitionCN: 连词，义为「而」，在同一句中连接两个对比分句。

entries.definition: An adjective meaning not alike; formal and used of things, not people's habits.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「不相似的」，较正式，多用于物。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the plain un- plus like structure and the contrast phrases the word appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子使用 un 加 like 的朴素结构，以及这个词出现的对比搭配。

normal.en: Un- means not and like means similar: not similar to.
normal.cn: un- 表示「不」，like 表示「像」：不像。

normal.en: Unlike her brother, she never breaks a cup: the phrase opens a contrast.
normal.cn: unlike her brother 意为与她弟弟不同；这个短语一开头就摆出对比。

normal.en: Unlike means not like, and it is the opposite of like rather than of likely.
normal.cn: unlike 意为「不像」，反义是 like 而不是 likely。

normal.en: Alike takes no un-: the pair is like and unlike, alike and unalike.
normal.cn: alike 不加 un-：配对的是 like 与 unlike、alike 与 unalike。

normal.en: To call a person unlike their usual self is to stress that this is not their habit.
normal.cn: 用 unlike 说某人反常，就是强调这不像他平时的样子。

abstract.en: Picture two shells of the same weight but a different shape: the hand feels at once that they are not of one family.
abstract.cn: 想象两枚重量相同而形状不同的贝壳：手一摸就知道它们不是一家。

abstract.en: Unlike does not deny a relation; it denies sameness while keeping the comparison.
abstract.cn: unlike 不否认关系，它否认相同，同时保留比较。

abstract.en: Every contrast needs two things put side by side, and the word is the space between them.
abstract.cn: 每个对比都需要两样东西并排，这个词就是它们之间的那段距离。

examples.en: Unlike most of his friends, he walks to work every day.
examples.cn: 与他多数朋友不同，他每天走路上班。

examples.en: The twins are unlike in temperament but close in spirit.
examples.cn: 这对双胞胎性情不同，感情却很好。

examples.en: It is unlike him to complain without a reason.
examples.cn: 无缘无故地抱怨不像他的为人。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「安的莱克」——安和莱克完全不像：不像、与……不同

root: 由否定前缀 un- 与古英语 gelīc（形体相同的，源于 līc「身体」）构成，古英语已有 ungelīc；中古英语定型为 unlike，作形容词与介词，近代在句首成为引出对比的标准说法。

sensesIntro.en: Five senses of unlike all deny sameness while keeping a comparison: two people, two things, one person and their usual self, two places, or one thing and everything else.
sensesIntro.cn: unlike 的五个义项都否认相同却保留比较：两个人、两样东西、一个人与其平时的样子、两个地方，或一样东西与其余一切。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two shells side by side, obviously not of one family.
core.cn: 核心意象：两枚并排的贝壳，一眼就看得出不是一家。

branches.en: THE PAIR: one person set against another, as a preposition.
branches.cn: 对照线：一个人与另一个人相对，作介词。

branches.en: THE SHAPE: the adjective says the two are not alike in nature.
branches.cn: 形状线：形容词说两者性质上并不相像。

branches.en: THE HABIT: a person unlike their usual self.
branches.cn: 习惯线：一个人不像平时的自己。

branches.en: THE OPENING: unlike at the head of a clause sets up the contrast.
branches.cn: 开头线：unlike 置于句首，摆出对比。

branches.en: THE UNMATCHED: unlike anything leaves nothing to compare with.
branches.cn: 无偶线：unlike anything 表示无从比较。

intro.en: Unlike is a native prefix on a native adjective, with English suffixes for the rest of the family.
intro.cn: unlike 是本土前缀加本土形容词，家族其余成员由英语后缀构成。

latinIntro.en: No Latin here; the roots are Old English, and later Latin-based synonyms are listed only for comparison.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁成分；词根是古英语，列出的拉丁语来源近义词仅供对照。

items.example: The ancestor of like and alike.
items.exampleCN: like 与 alike 的祖先。

items.example: Already recorded before the Norman period.
items.exampleCN: 诺曼征服之前已有记录。

definition_zh: 不太可能的；未必会发生的；不大可信的；（人）不像是真的
definition_en: not probable, or hard to believe when told
core_image: 一条窄路通向高处的城堡，看着就上不去
scene: 大家都以为他考不过，可他自己偷偷每天早起做题。It is unlikely that he will fail.
sceneCN: 这里 unlikely 是「不大可能的」（第 1 个义项：发生机会小）；句意为他不太可能考不过。一条看着就上不去的窄路，正是这个词的核心画面。

derivatives.zh: 去掉否定前缀的形容词，义为「可能的」
形容词加 -ness 构成名词，义为「不太可能」
由 likely 派生的名词，义为「可能性」
由 like 派生的名词，义为「相似」

senses.title: Not expected to happen
senses.definition: having little chance of happening or being true
senses.definitionCN: 发生或成立的可能性很小
senses.example: A change of plan this late seems unlikely.
senses.exampleCN: 这么晚再改计划看来不太可能。
senses.why: Like used to mean similar, and likely meant probable; removing that leaves little chance.
senses.whyCN: like 古义为「相似」，likely 意为「可能」，去掉这份相似，剩下的就是机会甚微。

senses.title: Used with a verb in the infinitive
senses.definition: used as be unlikely to plus a verb to say a thing will probably not happen
senses.definitionCN: 用作 be unlikely to 加动词，说明某事大概不会发生
senses.example: She is unlikely to arrive before ten.
senses.exampleCN: 她大概十点前到不了。
senses.why: Probability attached to a person turns into a prediction about that person actions.
senses.whyCN: 挂在人身上的「可能性」，就转成了关于此人行为的推测。

senses.title: Someone or something in the wrong place
senses.definition: used of a person or place that is surprising in a particular role
senses.definitionCN: 形容某人在某角色或某地出现得令人吃惊
senses.example: The old garage became an unlikely art gallery.
senses.exampleCN: 那间旧车库成了一个意想不到的画廊。
senses.why: A thing that does not resemble its expected role is literally unlike it.
senses.whyCN: 与预期角色不像的东西，字面上就是「不像」。

senses.title: Hard to believe when told
senses.definition: used of a story that is hard to accept as true
senses.definitionCN: 形容难以当作真事接受的叙述
senses.example: He told an unlikely story about a missed ferry.
senses.exampleCN: 他讲了个关于错过渡船的、不大可信的故事。
senses.why: What is improbable in fact is also improbable in belief, so one word serves both.
senses.whyCN: 事实上的不可能，与相信上的不可能本是同一回事，一个词就兼顾了。

senses.title: A pairing that should not work
senses.definition: used of partnerships or combinations that succeed against expectation
senses.definitionCN: 形容出人意料却奏效的搭档或组合
senses.example: Their unlikely friendship lasted forty years.
senses.exampleCN: 他们这段意想不到的友谊维持了四十年。
senses.why: Two things that resemble nothing of each other should not fit, yet here they do.
senses.whyCN: 彼此毫不相像的两样东西本不该合适，这里却恰好合适。

intro.en: Likely grew from like meaning similar, and un- was added to deny probability.
intro.cn: likely 由意为「相似」的 like 发展而来，un- 则用来否定其可能性。

items.en: Gelic meant having the same form, from a Germanic root for body or form.
items.cn: gelic 意为「形态相同」，词根在日耳曼语中指形体。

items.en: Likely first meant similar in appearance, then probable.
items.cn: likely 初指外貌相似，后转为「可能的」。

items.en: Un- was prefixed to likely for what is hardly expected.
items.cn: 在 likely 前加 un-，表示几乎不会被预期的事。

items.en: Be unlikely to became a fixed pattern for predictions.
items.cn: be unlikely to 成为固定预测句型。

items.en: Unlikely also describes people and places used in surprising roles.
items.cn: unlikely 也用来形容出现在意外角色中的人与地方。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the like family, and the near-meaning group gathers probability words.
note.cn: 形近组是 like 词族，近义组汇集表示可能性的词。

entries.definition: probable
different from
a resemblance
hard to like
entries.definitionCN: 不讨人喜欢的（只是拼写相近，词源不同）

entries.definition: not likely to happen
unlikely or uncertain
hard to believe

normalIntro.en: The word denies resemblance: if things are not alike, the chance is small.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词否定的是「相似」：彼此不像，机会自然就小。

normal.en: Un- plus likely: not probable.
normal.cn: un- 加 likely：不大可能。

normal.en: Be unlikely to do is the pattern to remember for predictions.
normal.cn: be unlikely to do 是预测时需要记住的句型。

normal.en: Highly unlikely is the common intensifier.
normal.cn: highly unlikely 是常用的加强说法。

normal.en: Like also means similar, which explains the root.
normal.cn: like 还有「相似」之义，这解释了它的词根。

normal.en: An unlikely hero is a favourite phrase in news writing.
normal.cn: an unlikely hero 是新闻写作中的常用说法。

abstract.en: Picture a narrow path climbing to a castle that seems unreachable.
abstract.cn: 想象一条窄路通向看似上不去的城堡。

abstract.en: See two people who share no taste in anything, laughing together.
abstract.cn: 看两个毫无共同爱好的人一起大笑。

abstract.en: Hear a weather report promise snow in June.
abstract.cn: 听天气预报说六月有雪。

examples.en: It is unlikely that the shop will open on Sunday.
examples.cn: 这家店星期天不太可能开门。

examples.en: He is unlikely to agree without reading it first.
examples.cn: 不先读一遍，他不太可能同意。

examples.en: The station became an unlikely setting for an opera.
examples.cn: 火车站成了一个意想不到的歌剧舞台。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「俺来客利」——俺来客人了？这年月不太可能，怕是弄错了。

root: 前缀 un-（不）+ likely，likely 源自古英语 gelic（形态相同），词根在日耳曼语中意为「形体」，由「相似」转义为「可能的」

sensesIntro.en: One denied resemblance covers chance, prediction, surprising roles, shaky stories, and odd pairs.
sensesIntro.cn: 一次对「相似」的否定，覆盖几率、预测、意外的角色、可疑的故事与奇怪的组合。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a narrow path climbing to a castle that looks unreachable.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条通向看似上不去的城堡的窄路。

branches.en: The chance branch: little likelihood of happening.
branches.cn: 几率分支：发生的可能很小。

branches.en: The prediction branch: people unlikely to act.
branches.cn: 预测分支：人们不太会做的事。

branches.en: The setting branch: a person or place in the wrong role.
branches.cn: 场景分支：出现在意料之外角色里的人或地。

branches.en: The belief branch: a story that will not convince.
branches.cn: 相信分支：说服不了人的叙述。

branches.en: The pairing branch: a match that should not work.
branches.cn: 组合分支：本不该合适的搭配。

intro.en: A negative prefix on an adjective that came from an old word for likeness.
intro.cn: 否定前缀压在一个源自「相似」古词的形容词上。

latinIntro.en: The root is Germanic rather than Latin, so the Latin list is empty.
latinIntro.cn: 词根属日耳曼语而非拉丁语，因此拉丁词条留空。

items.exampleCN: 想法相近的人所见略同。
like 加 un- 成为 unlike，意为不同。

items.example: An improbable win is still a win.
items.exampleCN: 不太可能的胜利也是胜利。

items.example: An implausible excuse convinced no one.
items.exampleCN: 一个难以信服的理由没能说服人。

items.example: It is doubtful the plan will work.
items.exampleCN: 这个计划能否奏效值得怀疑。

definition_zh: 直到；到……为止；直到……才；（否定句）直到……才
definition_en: up to the time when something happens or ends
core_image: 走廊尽头的灯一直亮着，亮到门开为止
scene: 母亲坐在客厅没关灯，说要等孩子进门她才去睡。She waited in the hall until the last bus arrived.
sceneCN: 这里 until 是「直到……为止」（第 1 个义项：动作持续到某时）；句意为她在门厅一直等到末班车到达。走廊的灯亮到门开为止的画面，正是这个词的核心。

derivatives.zh: 同义的较短形式，义为「直到」，口语中更常用
形近但不同源，义为「不合时宜的」（只是拼写相近，词源不同）

senses.title: Action that continues up to a point in time
senses.definition: used to say that an action goes on and stops at a certain time
senses.definitionCN: 表示动作持续进行，到某一时间停止
senses.example: The shop stays open until nine.
senses.exampleCN: 这家店开到九点。
senses.why: The word marks the end point of a stretch of time, and the thing before that point simply keeps going.
senses.whyCN: 这个词标出一段时间的终点，在此之前的事情就一直在持续。

senses.title: Not before a certain time
senses.definition: used with a negative or in a question to mean not happening before a time
senses.definitionCN: 与否定或疑问连用，表示在某一时间之前没有发生
senses.example: He did not answer until the third knock.
senses.exampleCN: 直到敲第三下他才应门。
senses.why: If a line marks where something stops, then nothing has happened on the near side of it; this is the negative reading.
senses.whyCN: 既然一条线标出某事停止的地方，那么线这一侧就还什么都没发生，这正是否定用法。

senses.title: A limit set on a rule
senses.definition: used of rules and notices that last up to a stated point
senses.definitionCN: 用于规定或通告，表示有效到某一时点
senses.example: The office is closed until Monday.
senses.exampleCN: 办公室关到星期一。
senses.why: A notice needs an end point, and the word supplies exactly the point where the rule stops.
senses.whyCN: 通告需要一个终点，这个词提供的正是规定停止的那一点。

senses.title: A change that finally comes
senses.definition: used when a state lasts and then finally gives way
senses.definitionCN: 表示某种状态一直持续，最后才改变
senses.example: The noise went on until someone complained.
senses.exampleCN: 吵闹一直继续，直到有人投诉才停。
senses.why: When a stretch is long, the moment it ends is also the moment something turns, so the word gathers a sense of turning.
senses.whyCN: 当这一段很长时，它结束的那一刻也正是事情转折的一刻，于是这个词带上了转折意味。

senses.title: Until then in narrative
senses.definition: used in stories for the time before an event happens
senses.definitionCN: 在叙述中指某事发生之前的那段时间
senses.example: Until that night, nobody in the village locked a door.
senses.exampleCN: 在那晚之前，村里没人锁门。
senses.why: In a story the same end point can be read backwards, naming all the time before the event arrives.
senses.whyCN: 在故事里，同一个终点也可以反着读，指事件到来之前的整段时间。

intro.en: An old compound preposition whose first part survives in our northern word for the same thing.
intro.cn: 一个古老的复合介词，其前一部分仍保存在同义的北方说法里。

items.en: The form und means up to, and the older Scandinavian words spread it into English.
items.cn: und 意为「直到」，更早的斯堪的纳维亚语形式把它带进英语。

items.en: Till was already used for up to a time, and it is not a shortened form of until.
items.cn: till 早已表示「直到」，它并不是 until 的缩写。

items.en: Untill appears as a reinforced till, with un- here meaning up to rather than not.
items.cn: untill 作为加强形式的 till 出现，此处 un- 意为「直到」，并非否定。

items.en: Until and till are used side by side, until being more formal in writing.
items.cn: until 与 till 并行使用，写作中 until 更正式。

items.en: Not until opens a clause and forces the main verb to come late, a favourite of formal prose.
items.cn: not until 引导从句并使主动词后置，是正式文章偏爱的结构。

note.en: The look-alike group collects time prepositions and similar spellings, while the near-meaning group compares end points.
note.cn: 形近组收集时间介词与相近拼写，近义组比较表示终点的时间词。
